sections.heading: Blood Test Ke Liye Khaali Pet Kitne Ghante — Aur Kaunsa Slot
sections.lead: Fasting bhookh ki wajah se mushkil nahi hoti. Wo tab mushkil hoti hai jab slot dopahar ka le liya jaye — phir subah se bhookhe baithna padta hai.
blocks: Sabse pehle ek galat-fehmi door kar lijiye: har test ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori nahi hota. Fasting sirf fasting sugar aur lipid profile me lagti hai, aur isi wajah se zyadatar package me lagti hai — kyunki package me ye dono aa jaate hain. HbA1c, TSH, CBC, Vitamin D aur B12 me bilkul nahi lagti. Ghar par sample dene ka sabse seedha faayda yahi hai ki bhookhe pet kahin nikalna nahi padta — sample uthte hi ho jaata hai aur naashta wahin.

Is ilaake me subah ka slot sheher se bhi zyada kaam ka hai. Khet ka kaam, doodh ka kaam aur dukaan — sab subah shuru ho jaate hain, aur 10-12 ghante khaali pet rehne ke baad koi din bhar bhookha nahi baith sakta. Isliye:

list: Subah 6 baje wala pehla slot hi lijiye. Slot jitna aage khiskega, bhookhe rehne ka waqt utna hi badhega.

Paani band mat kijiye. Paani ki kami se do cheezein hoti hain: nas milna mushkil ho jaata hai, aur haemoglobin, urea tatha creatinine jhoothe taur par badhe hue chhapte hain.
14 ghante se zyada khaali pet rehna ulta nuksan karta hai. "Jitna zyada khaali pet, utni sahi report" — ye baat sach nahi hai.

faqs.answer: Form bharne ya call karne ke baad lagbhag 30 minute me confirmation call aati hai, jisme slot aur pata pakka kiya jaata hai. Tay samay par phlebotomist ID card ke saath ghar aata hai, naam aur test milaata hai, sample leta hai, aur tube par naam wahin aapke saamne likhta hai. Poori visit me 10 se 15 minute lagte hain. Payment sample lene ke waqt cash ya UPI se hota hai, aur report 24 ghante ke andar PDF me phone par aa jaati hai.

faqs.question: Blood test ke liye khaali pet kitne ghante rehna padta hai?
faqs.answer: Jin test me fasting lagti hai unke liye 10 se 12 ghante. Lekin har test me nahi lagti — sirf fasting sugar, lipid profile aur zyadatar package me lagti hai. CBC, HbA1c, thyroid, Vitamin D aur B12 me bilkul nahi lagti. Raat ka khana 9 baje tak kar lijiye aur subah 6 ya 7 ka slot lijiye; itne me 10 se 12 ghante apne aap poore ho jaate hain. Beech me saada paani peete rahiye — wo fasting nahi todta. 14 ghante se zyada bhookhe rehna faayda nahi karta.

faqs.question: Salempur me ghar se sample dene par report kitne din me aati hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar test ki report 24 ghante ke andar PDF me phone par aa jaati hai — CBC, sugar, HbA1c, lipid, LFT, KFT, thyroid, vitamin aur urine routine sab isme. Sirf culture wale test alag hain; urine ya blood culture me 48 se 72 ghante lagte hain, kyunki culture ko badhne ka samay dena padta hai. Report WhatsApp ya email par milti hai, isliye Deoria ya Gorakhpur me dikhana ho to print le kar chalna zaroori nahi.

faqs.question: Bhatni, Lar ya Bhatpar Rani se bhi ghar par sample liya jaata hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, Salempur ke aas-paas ke kasbon aur gaon se sample liya jaata hai, aur home collection ka koi alag charge nahi judta — door hone ki wajah se bhi nahi. Booking me pata landmark ke saath likhiye: gaon ka naam, sabse paas ka school, mandir, bank ya chauraha, aur do phone number. Gaon ke pate me landmark hi sabse tez tarika hota hai, aur visit late hone ki sabse aam wajah yahi cheez chhoot jaana hai.

faqs.question: Kya poora full body checkup bhi ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Poora package ek hi baar nas se liye gaye khoon par ho jaata hai — har test ke liye alag sui nahi lagti. Urine routine bhi package me ho to container pehle se de diya jaata hai, aur subah ka pehla peshab sabse achha maana jaata hai. Package me lipid aur fasting sugar hote hain, isliye 10 se 12 ghante khaali pet rehna padega — subah 6 baje ka slot lijiye, sample ke turant baad naashta ho jaata hai.
